title: Agentic process evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.40071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The way software gets built is changing dramatically. AI agents now create pull requests, select dependencies, refactor codebases, interpret test failures, and execute infrastructure changes across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). AI agents are autonomous team members, but unlike human engineers, they are ephemeral - their reasoning, decisions, and tool calls vanish the moment the session ends. Modern Security incidents involving intent mismatch or injection are becoming increasingly common - forcing us to address AI Agents as an insider threat. No widely adopted standard yet enables agentic provenance and governance and its obvious that you can't hold an ephemeral process accountable. The git log was designed for human commits. translated_abstract: 软件的构建方式正在发生剧变。AI 智能体现在能够创建拉取请求、选择依赖项、重构代码库、解读测试失败原因，并在整个软件开发生命周期（SDLC）中执行基础设施变更。AI 智能体是自主的团队成员，但与人类工程师不同，它们是短暂的——会话一旦结束，它们的推理、决策和工具调用便随之消失。涉及意图偏差或注入攻击的现代安全事件日益频发，这迫使我们不得不将 AI 智能体视为一种内部威胁。目前尚无被广泛采用的标准能够实现智能体的来源追溯与治理，而显而易见的是，你无法让一个短暂易逝的过程承担责任。git log 是为人类提交而设计的，它只显示改动了什么，却无法显示 AI 智能体做了什么、使用了哪个模型、调用了哪些工具，以及是否有人对结果负责。每一个治理框架、每一次审……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出“智能体过程证据”这一新标准概念，用以记录 AI 智能体在软件开发生命周期中的行为（包括所用模型、工具调用与决策过程），使短暂易逝的智能体行为可被追溯、治理和问责。
en_tdlr: Introduces the concept of "agentic process evidence" — a standard to record what AI agents did across the SDLC (models used, tool calls, decisions), enabling provenance, governance, and accountability for otherwise ephemeral AI agents.
